Gardevoir

Psychic Fairy

Hoenn · Generation 3

Gardevoir is a Psychic/Fairy-type Embrace Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 1.6 m tall and weighs 48.4 kg. It evolves from Kirlia. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (125), with a base stat total of 518.
